name: Sprint 1 — Testing Infrastructure
description: Establish the complete BelzontWE.Tests project foundation: .csproj, game DLL reference strategy, InternalsVisibleTo, folder conventions, TTF font fixture, MSBuild integration, CI pipeline, and smoke test pipeline validation.
